create_mole_layer: create a MOLE linear layer with multiple experts and global mixing coefficients for molecular systems
create_moledgl_layer: create a MOLEDGL layer that uses fairchem_cpp segment_mm for accelerated expert-weighted linear transforms
init_linear_experts: initialize random weight and bias parameters for a given number of experts using kaiming-style scaling
compute_interval_intersection: compute the intersection of two numeric intervals and return the overlapping range or None
merge_mole_to_linear: merge a MOLE multi-expert layer into a single standard nn.Linear layer using current mixing coefficients
